requirements.text: Declares a typed schema: title text, price a decimal number of pounds, copies in stock an integer, rating constrained to 1..5, description text.
Has a language model read the page to fill the schema, with no hand-written selectors.
Chooses the model by name in the program (argument, setting or flag), and the same path works for a locally served model (e.g. Ollama) as for a hosted one.
Prints the tokens used and their cost next to the extracted result.
When a field is absent from the page or the answer does not have the expected type, reports which field instead of returning an empty or wrong value.
Closes what it opens (connection/Run or browser/Stagehand) and awaits its calls.

programs.notes: Model named by argv/env and set as ai.model on the connection; extract in model mode with a Zod schema (rating as literal union); extraction_incomplete/extraction_invalid reported per field path via duck-typed error checks, with usage on errors; await using closes everything.

Pydantic Book with Decimal price and Literal[1..5] rating, model from --model or env passed per call and in settings; ExtractionIncompleteError and ExtractionInvalidError name each field; usage and price printed, unpriced handled; async with closes.

Model from argv set as ai.model on the Run; custom deserializers for price and rating are rejections fed back to the model per the data.rs doc; details::<ExtractionIncomplete>/<ExtractionInvalid> name fields; run and connection closed (Run closed rather than finished, which only stops it).

api_misuses.assumed: also shuts down the browser launched with localBrowser.launch()
api_misuses.doc_says: Stagehand 4.2.1's close() only ends its RPC session and releases its claim on the browser handle; the launched Chrome stays open until browser.close() is called

programs.notes: Nullable schema plus a hand validator names missing or mistyped fields, and a local OpenAI-compatible ClientLLM callback covers local models; but the launched browser is never closed, and a hosted model's cost is printed only if the user sets PRICE_* environment variables, otherwise 'unknown'.
Model reference from argv/env passed per call, extract in model mode with a Zod schema; Incomplete/Invalid errors listed per field path with usage; await using closes the connection and Run.

Sync API with ai.model from --model (default vercel/openai/gpt-4o-mini, local ollama/... accepted); float price is a decimal number as in the TypeScript versions; both extraction errors name fields and print usage; with blocks close everything.

Model from argv set as ai.model on the Run, schemars range on rating, extract in model mode; ExtractionIncomplete/ExtractionInvalid details name each field and usage is printed on success and failure; Run and connection closed.

api_misuses.assumed: also shuts down the browser launched with localBrowser.launch()
api_misuses.doc_says: Stagehand 4.2.1's close() only ends its RPC session and releases its claim on the browser handle; the launched Chrome stays open until browser.close() is called

programs.notes: Lenient nullable schema then per-field Zod checks name missing or mistyped fields, tokens from stagehand.metrics(), local model via a ClientLLM callback; but the launched browser is never closed, and a hosted model's cost is 'unknown' unless PRICE_* environment variables are set.
